description_ru: Трое друзей обсуждают, как провести выходные, если погода будет плохой.
text:
Tom: So, what are we doing this weekend? Have you checked the weather?
Nina: I have, and it isn't good. It will rain all day on Saturday.
Ben: That's a shame. I wanted to go to the lake.
Nina: We could go on Sunday instead. The forecast says it will be sunny then.
Tom: Fine, but what shall we do on Saturday? If we stay at home, we will just watch television.
Ben: Why don't we visit the new science museum? I have heard that it has a huge space exhibition.
Nina: Good idea! I have never been there, and my brother says that the planetarium is amazing.
Tom: How much are the tickets?
Ben: Twelve pounds for adults, but students pay half price. If we book online, we can skip the queue.
Tom: Great, thanks. Then let's meet at the bus stop at ten o'clock.
Nina: I think ten is too early for me. I never wake up before nine on Saturdays. How about eleven?
Ben: Eleven is fine. We can have lunch at the café there.
Tom: And on Sunday, shall we take sandwiches to the lake?
Nina: Yes, and I will bring some chocolate. If it's very sunny, we might even swim.
Ben: The water will be freezing! But I'm in.
Tom: Perfect. See you on Saturday!

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы в трубочку и быстро раздвиньте их; зубы не касаются нижней губы, иначе получится «в».
Кончик языка слегка просуньте между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «ф».
Язык между зубами, как для θ, но с голосом: горло вибрирует. Не говорите «з» или «д».

questions.question: What will the weather be like on Saturday?
Where do they decide to go on Saturday?
What will they do on Sunday?
questions.answer: Go to the lake and have a picnic.
